#Text=feat: add first-class support for CJK (#8530)
#Text=feat: add first-class support for CJK
#Text=**Business value**
#Text=1. Introduced `Xiaolai-Regular` for CJK as a fallback font for Excalifont
#Text=- it was additionally adjusted to fit our needs
#Text=- removed non-CJK codepoints
#Text=- reduced any Hangul side-bearings to 40%
#Text=- centered in width of inproperly centered CJK codepoints (mainly Hangul Jamo, but also others)
#Text=- it was manually split into multiple woff2 font faces for lazy-loading with https://chinese-font.netlify.app/online-split
#Text=1. Improved wrapping to handle CJK codepoints, according to the special CJK rules (especially for Japanese and Korean)
#Text=1. Added support for multicodepoint Emojis wrapping (in other words, emojis won't be broken apart during wrapping anymore)
#Text=1. Added keyboard shortcut for SVG export (`ctrl+shift+c` on all the platforms) with a toast once completed (similar to PNG).
#Text=1. Mitigated subsequent FOUT by fixing local caching for fonts hosted on our CDN (previously cross-origin requests for fonts were not being cached by the service-worker).
#Text=Completes #8408
#Text=**Technical parts**
#Text=[изображение]
#Text=https://link.excalidraw.com/readonly/MbbnWPSWXgadXdtmzgeO
#Text=1. Improved overall SVG export to process `FontFace`s concurrently (with or without workers, fetching and processing max 3 at a time) with some additional perf. optimisations.

#Text=1. Offloaded SVG export in `excalidraw-app` to shortlived `Web Workers` (re-used or terminated after 500ms of inactivity) due to performance issues on the main thread (i.e. just Xiaolai consists of about 250 font faces, which would make the editor unresponsive for a few seconds).
#Text=- as part of this introduced initial infra for a pool of short-lived idle workers (could be possibly re-used elsewhere)
#Text=- added fallback for the main thread in case the `Web Workers` are not available (i.e. running in server-side or when everything is one chunk as in the obsidian)
#Text=- for more fallbacks check the `The NOT so happy path` in the diagram

#Text=1. Adjusted the SVG export to inline fallback fonts first, so that their glyphs get overridden by the default fonts. Refactored font and `ExcalidrawFontFace`-related logic and fixed various perf. / caching issues (i.e. bail in font faces cache not working)
#Text=1. Adjusted the utils build process to merge all existing fonts with the big CJK font (with normalized glyphs, merged licenses, etc.).
#Text=1. Adjusted the whole process for the E+ server-side export (processed on the main thread, fetched dataurl, skipped unnecessary expected logging, etc.).
#Text=1. Introduced initial infra for manual code splitting (lazy load **/*.chunk.js in `excalidraw-app`, create separate chunks in esbuild).
